messages:
liam: Quick midday check — cut window in 30m. current train head is release/v1.25.0, please flag any must-have cherry-picks now.
maya: pushing #1321 (kv-cache fix) — running CI now, will ping when green.
ashok: FYI I reverted the experimental batching tweak on staging; it caused 95th p95 spikes. Not blocking cut but prefer backport if #1321 doesn't land.
release-bot: Deploy check: all services nominal. Canary passes (3/3). Auto-scaling OK.
sara: any blockers on the backports? I have bandwidth to help cherry-pick if needed.
maya: CI failing on perf-integration: flaky timeout in perf/sequence_length_test. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/9876
maya: short log snippet:
```
AssertionError: latency > 200ms
at test_sequence_length (tests/perf/test_sequence.py:42)
```
maya: rerunning with increased retry timeout now.
liam: if perf tests don't green in 20m we may gate the backport; don't want to risk roll-forward regressions.
oliver: PR #1304 (retry logic) is green and can be backported. I've prepared the cherry-pick branch: git checkout -b backport/1304 && git cherry-pick -x abc123
ashok: noted. I'll take #1304 and run staging perf quick-run.
sara: I'm oncall for the release window — will monitor metrics and can rollback if error rate >0.5%.
liam: @maya @ashok prioritize KV fix first. if CI still flaky, tag me and i'll approve manual merge after smoke run.
release-bot: Rollout schedule: cut at 15:40 UTC, canary -> 15:55, full by 16:30. Alerts will be posted to #incidents if triggered.
maya: CI green on #1321 — pushing cherry-pick now to rel/backports/1321
maya: done — branch: rel/backports/1321, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1333
liam: awesome. @sara can you validate canary once it starts? specifically latency and error-rate dashboards.
sara: will do. Have runbook page open.
oliver: small note — watch for quota spike on the dedicated pool during canary; throttling observed yesterday. I bumped burst to +10% for window.
ashok: staging perf run for #1304 done — no regressions seen in the short-run. passing.
liam: OK green across the board. Let's proceed with cut. thanks everyone :tada:
sara: monitoring now — ping me if you need immediate rollback.
liam: closing this thread — updates will go to #incidents if anything unexpected.
